scope: Independent static source review of the frozen feature-only exporter V4 and scorer V5 producer/consumer bindings. This resolves a local source-pair gate only; it is not B admission, execution, export acceptance, scoring, or a quality claim.

exporter_v3_to_v4: Bind the V4 filename and exact bytes/SHA of EXPORT_BINDING_V4.json.
Bind the new evaluation_v3 evidence/output root.

Validate serialized checkpoint input_lead with canonical default semantics: a missing field or strict integer zero is accepted; booleans, null, strings, and nonzero values are rejected. Other fixed checkpoint arguments and state checks remain in the existing validator.

scorer_v4_to_v5.only_operational_change: Normalize each compact source.api_files leaf against the matching full source-manifest row by path, then require exact {bytes, sha256} leaf keys, strict positive integer byte count, lowercase 64-character SHA-256, and equal byte/hash values.

focused_fixture_scope.exporter_fixture_scope: Canonical CLI/checkpoint argument defaults and typed input_lead handling with bounded synthetic metadata; no model/data payloads read by this reviewer.
focused_fixture_scope.score_fixture_scope: Calls the actual full _read_export_bundle metadata gate with exact V4 binding and canonical 167-row source-manifest bytes plus synthetic completion metadata; rejects mutated API bytes, hashes, paths, and unexpected fields; opens no prediction arrays.

limitations: The dependency manifest still contains its preparation-time pending source-review label; this report is the local source-pair review receipt and does not rewrite frozen dependency bytes.
No actual export-v3 unit invocation, export acceptance, prediction files, score, or quality result is established by this review.

reviewer_conclusion: The frozen V4 exporter and V5 scorer now agree on the exact V4 binding, 167-file source manifest and eight compact canonical API pins, evaluation_v3 evidence/output paths, and fixed five-arm feature-only export contract.
